scope: Current Keys prototype. Presentation consistency across primary scenarios, common secondary pages and sheets. This is coverage of the listed views, not every possible combination of content or order state.

checks.computedTypography: All sampled text uses Golos Text Variable and the documented type scale; plus/minus controls retain icon glyph sizes.
checks.navigation: Host and embedded Find navigation: 12 px / 15 px at 320 and 375 px.
checks.pageWidth: No document horizontal overflow in eight home scenarios and Find at both widths.
checks.textWidth: No sampled text box wider than viewport in the 46 listed views at either width. Horizontal photo and hotel carousels deliberately remain scrollable.
checks.buttons: Standalone pre-arrival action is 48 px; paired multiline actions are equal at 66 px, both with 14 px type and 14 px radius.
checks.runtime: No page errors captured in the main 39-view browser audit at either width.
checks.preservation: Original 67 inline scripts unchanged; legacy presentation adjusted through adapters.

artifacts: tmp/style-audit/ (computed styles, screenshots, test log; local verification artifacts)
